commitResults.messageBody:

prefix, leaving the user to look up the remaining fields in the UG.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document duplicate detection and project effort
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a DG implementation section on duplicate detection and
possible-typo warnings with an activity diagram, a manual test for
names with relation markers, and the optional Effort appendix that PE
testers read before rating implementation effort. Show a sample
possible-typo warning in the UG and note that curly and straight
apostrophes in names are treated as different characters.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Show complete engagement fields in tooltips
commitResults.messageBody:
Engagement fields can be clipped in the list, requiring users to open
the details dialog to inspect individual values.

Add wrapped tooltips for the six displayed fields and document hovering
as an additional way to read complete values. Verify tooltip contents
for different cards using a focused, opt-in JavaFX test.
